newsitem.title: USA: Healthdyne looks at alternatives to Invacare.
newsitem.headline: Healthdyne looks at alternatives to Invacare.

text.p: Healthdyne Technologies Inc said Monday it was exploring alternatives to a takeover offer from rival medical equipment maker Invacare Corp .
Healthdyne said alternatives included a possible merger or acquisition with or by another party, and possible transactions employing leverage to deliver value to its shareholders.
Invacare, which recently raised its tender offer for Healthdyne to $15 per share, said today it had extended its offer to August 1 from June 20.

Invacare said that as of June 20, 3.9 million shares of Healthdyne common had been tendered to it. These shares, together with 600,000 Healthdyne shares already owned by Invacare, represent more than 35 percent of Healthdyne's outstanding common stock, the suitor said.
Healthdyne, in a letter to Invacare, described the takeover offer as "grossly inadequate."

Healthdyne said it has not made any decision to pursue a particular alternative, but Healthdyne Chairman Parker Petit said it was "prudent to talk to third parties" to find out what alternatives existed.
